paragraphs: Rav Yehuda son of Rav Yitzchak.

[Taanit 6b](https://www.sefaria.org/Taanit.6b.10) has Abaye citing Rav Yehudah, son of Rav Yitzchak. Hyman reports the reading Rav Shmuel, son of Rav Yitzchak, in Dikdukei Soferim and compares it with [Berakhot 59a](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.59a.11).
Zohar, Chayei Sarah, at folio 126, mentions Yehudah bar Yitzchak. Hyman cites Midrash Tehillim 55:1 and Midrash Shmuel 14:2 for Rabbi Yudan, son of Rabbi Yitzchak.[^2]

notes.text: The consulted Taanit 6b reads Yehudah bar Yitzchak. The exact Dikdukei Soferim Shmuel reading and the Zohar and Midrash edition readings cited here have not been independently inspected and remain Hyman’s report; no identity equivalence is inferred.

In [Berakhot 59a](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.59a.11) the speaker is Rabbi Shmuel bar Yitzchak. The [Seder HaDorot entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1726&lang=en) cites Taanit for Rav Yehudah. The corresponding [Zohar Online, Chayei Sara 127a](https://www.zoharonline.org/zohar/volume-1/chayei-sara/daf-127a/) passage names Rabbi Yehudah bar Yitzchak in a discussion about angels and their missions. Its folio differs from Hyman’s locator. The two Midrash readings remain unidentified in the consulted editions.
